时笙跑了一阵，才惊觉不对。

当时看到叶清秋拎着男主朝她冲过来，她也不知道哪根筋不对，拔腿就跑。

本宝宝跑什么啊？

又不是冲着本宝宝来的，遇到女主，智商都下线了。

就在时笙转弯准备溜的时候，后面的追他们的庞然大物一个急冲，甩着身躯拦在了她们前面。

“嘶嘶……”

时笙：“……”说好的龙呢？

怎么变成蛇了？

这是一条五丈多长的蟒蛇，腰身至少有三个人粗，高昂着脑袋，虎视眈眈的盯着她们，尾巴左右横扫，四周的树木顿时噼里哗啦的成片倒。

叶清秋心底有些疑惑，她看到的明明就是龙，怎么会变成蛇了？

难道……

她运气不会这么好吧？

“轰隆隆！”

似乎为了证明叶清秋的猜想，刚才白云蓝天的天空乌云密布，乌云中似有千军万马袭来，震耳欲聋的声音响彻天际。

“卧槽！”时笙骂了一声，转身就往后面跑。

丫的，这蛇要渡劫了啊！！

渡劫的雷劫哪里是她这个小小的筑基渣能承受得起的，赶紧跑！

时笙一跑，叶清秋也跟着她跑，她还带着昏迷的男主，速度竟然不比时笙慢。

最重要的是……

那条即将渡劫的大蛇跟在她们后面啊喂！！

因为剧情中，原主虽然参加这次行动，但是她可没有中途下，自然不会遇到现在这么一出，可是剧情里，女主也仅仅是在这里救了男主啊，并没有被蛇追这种经历！

她不过是砍了男主两下，这剧情就崩得面目全非了吗？

时笙留神观察了一下后面的大蛇，她发现这货是盯着叶清秋的，就算她慢了一步，大蛇也不会攻击她，反而紧盯着叶清秋。

“……”她不会是拿了大蛇什么东西吧？

按照女主的设定尿性，还真说不定……

【隐藏任务：君临天下】

久等麻袋，这种生死关头，你竟然发布任务，还有没有人性！

【宿主，本系统没有生命，自然不会有人性一说。】系统正儿八经的回答了时笙的吐槽。

所以，君临天下又是个什么梗？

【让凤辞登上仙帝宝座。】

Shi Sheng ran for a while before he realized something was wrong.

When she saw Ye Qingqiu rushing toward her with the male protagonist in his arms, she didn't know what was wrong, so she ran away.

Why is this baby running?

It’s not like I’m here for my baby. When I met the heroine, my IQ dropped.

Just when Shi Sheng turned around and was about to escape, the huge creature chasing them rushed forward and swung his body to stop them in front of them.

"Hiss..."

Shi Sheng: "..." Where is the promised dragon?

Why did you turn into a snake?

This was a python that was more than five feet long, with a waist as thick as at least three people. It held its head high and stared at them eagerly. Its tail swept left and right, and the surrounding trees suddenly fell in pieces.

Ye Qingqiu was a little confused in her heart. What she saw was obviously a dragon, how could it turn into a snake?

Could it be...

She won't be so lucky, right?

"Boom!"

As if to prove Ye Qingqiu's conjecture, the white and blue sky just now was covered with dark clouds. There seemed to be thousands of troops attacking in the dark clouds, and a deafening sound resounded across the sky.

"Fuck!" Shi Sheng cursed, turned around and ran back.

Damn it, this snake is going to be in trouble!!

There was no way a little foundation-building scum like her could bear the thunder tribulation of overcoming the tribulation, so run away!

As soon as Shi Sheng ran away, Ye Qingqiu also ran with her. She also took the unconscious male protagonist with her, and her speed was no slower than Shi Sheng.

The most important thing is...

The big snake that is about to pass the tribulation is following them!!

Because in the plot, although the original protagonist participated in this operation, she did not get off halfway, so naturally she would not encounter such an incident. However, in the plot, the female protagonist only saved the male protagonist here, and did not have the experience of being chased by a snake!

She just chopped the male protagonist twice, and the plot collapsed beyond recognition?

Shi Sheng carefully observed the big snake behind her, and she found that it was staring at Ye Qingqiu. Even if she took a step slower, the big snake would not attack her, but would stare at Ye Qingqiu.

"..." Did she take something from the big snake?

According to the heroine's setting of peeing, maybe...

[Hidden Mission: Dominate the World]

You have been waiting for a sack for a long time. At this critical moment of life and death, you actually issued a mission. Do you still have any humanity?

[Host, this system has no life, so naturally it has no humanity.】The system answered Shi Sheng's complaints in a serious manner.

So, what’s the point of Jun Lin Tian Xia?

[Let Feng Ci ascend the throne of the Immortal Emperor.】
